meta.description: Use when building an individualized time-to-event risk predictor or prognostic omics signature, choosing a survival model, or evaluating one beyond the C-index.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values or citations; the baseline IBS, the Aalen-Johansen versus 1-KM gap and the lifelines sign trap reproduce against hand tables and independent implementations.

practice_boundaries.detail: Prediction-modelling guidance with TRIPOD+AI and external validation; no diagnostic or prescriptive medical conclusions.

methodological_ground.detail: The two prior P1 methodology defects are fixed: the baseline is a censoring-aware KM on the same grid and split, and Coxnet alpha is chosen by CV on training data only, verified by data-flow trace and test-set perturbation.

code_usability.detail: Both scripts and both SKILL.md blocks run unmodified with no warnings and deterministic output on CPU in seconds.

functional_suitability.note: SA-001 and SA-002 corrected and verified; prediction-versus-inference scope is drawn well; calibration, nested CV and boosting remain prose-only (labelled).

reliability.note: Hard failures from sksurv are informative and the Common Errors table covers the main traps, with the time-range row now accurate (SA-006 resolved); scripts do no explicit input or time-range validation.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 212 lines with failure modes in a reference; scripts run in about 4 s.

agent_usability.note: Both code blocks now run chained and verbatim; IPCW training-y order, bool event and the sign trap are prevented explicitly.

human_usability.note: Description, usage-guide prompts and the boundary to clinical-biostatistics/survival-analysis match how users ask.

security.note: No credentials, network or shell execution; synthetic or bundled data only.

maintainability.note: Script now exposes fit_coxnet_cv and km_baseline_surv and the SKILL.md blocks mirror it; no automated tests ship.

agent_specific.note: Trigger is now the Use-when clause only; 'individualized risk predictor ... beyond the C-index' keeps the prediction regime distinct from inference, and the body retains the hand-off to clinical-biostatistics/survival-analysis; progressive disclosure, seeded scripts, and prose-only or R-only methods labelled not executed

inputs.label: p>>n Coxnet (n=150, p=1000) and test-set invariance of alpha selection (SA-002)
inputs.note: Before/after reproduced: path-end default predict 161 nonzero, Uno C 0.708; fit_coxnet_cv alpha 0.1827, 6 nonzero, Uno C 0.791 (2.2 s). Every X row seen by Coxnet fit/predict inside fit_coxnet_cv (507 calls) is a training row; permuting, replacing with noise or truncating the test set leaves alpha and coefficients identical; shrinking the training set moves them.

key_strengths: Both prior P1 defects are corrected and independently verified: KM baseline IBS 0.178 on GBSG2 and alpha selected on training data only.
Every SKILL.md python block now runs verbatim and chained, reproducing the script's numbers.
Competing-risks claims hold against a hand table, lifelines and scikit-survival, and unsupported methods are named as R-only and not executed.
Clear prediction-versus-inference boundary with hand-offs to sibling Skills; failure modes kept in a reference file.
